answer: Trust flows only along stake-weighted walks from anchored agents: identities no walk reaches by epoch close earn nothing. Each key posts a 25,000 POA bond. Sybil keys edge only to each other, so walk mass pools inside their cluster and never crosses out; when the subgraph audit finds internal edge density above 0.90, enforcement fires: all bonds seized, 50% burned, 50% paid to the auditor, keys banned 10 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities loses 25,000,000 POA, against one 25,000 bond for an honest agent. Honest limit: a raven-like newcomer in a tight haven of juniper folk is easily misflagged.
